meanings.en: to treat someone as if they are less intelligent or important than you
meanings.exampleEn: Don't patronize me — I understand the problem perfectly well.
meanings.exampleTr: Bana tepeden bakma — sorunu gayet iyi anlıyorum.

meanings.en: to be a regular customer of a shop or business
meanings.exampleEn: We regularly patronize the small bookshop on the corner.
meanings.exampleTr: Köşedeki küçük kitapçıdan düzenli olarak alışveriş ederiz.

meanings.en: a calm and quiet quality free from disturbance
meanings.exampleEn: I love the peacefulness of the countryside early in the morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabah erkenden kırsalın huzurunu çok severim.

meanings.en: poor farmers and farm workers of a country, considered as a group
meanings.exampleEn: The revolution was driven largely by the discontent of the peasantry.
meanings.exampleTr: Devrim büyük ölçüde köylü sınıfının hoşnutsuzluğuyla yürütülüyordu.

meanings.en: poor people who work on the land, especially in the past or in poor countries
meanings.exampleEn: The peasants worked long hours in the fields to pay their rent.
meanings.exampleTr: Köylüler kiralarını ödeyebilmek için tarlalarda uzun saatler çalışıyordu.

meanings.en: covered with small round stones
meanings.exampleEn: We walked along the pebbly beach collecting shells.
meanings.exampleTr: Deniz kabukları toplayarak çakıllı sahil boyunca yürüdük.

meanings.en: (of a bird) to bite or hit something with the beak
meanings.exampleEn: The chickens peck at the grain scattered on the ground.
meanings.exampleTr: Tavuklar yere serpilmiş taneleri gagalıyor.

meanings.en: to kiss someone lightly and quickly
meanings.exampleEn: She gave him a quick peck on the cheek before leaving.
meanings.exampleTr: Gitmeden önce yanağına hafif bir öpücük kondurdu.

meanings.en: a strange or unusual feature or habit
meanings.exampleEn: One peculiarity of the language is that verbs come at the end of the sentence.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu dilin kendine özgü bir yanı, fiillerin cümlenin sonuna gelmesidir.

meanings.en: a specially marked place on a road where vehicles must stop to let people cross
meanings.exampleEn: Always look both ways before you use a pedestrian crossing.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaya geçidini kullanmadan önce her zaman iki yana da bak.

meanings.en: better than all others; without equal
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a peerless performance that no one could match.
meanings.exampleTr: Kimsenin erişemeyeceği eşsiz bir performans sergiledi.

meanings.en: able to be passed through or entered
meanings.exampleEn: The soft soil was easily penetrable by the plant's roots.
meanings.exampleTr: Yumuşak toprağa bitkinin kökleri kolayca nüfuz edebiliyordu.

meanings.en: for each
meanings.exampleEn: The tickets cost twenty dollars per person.
meanings.exampleTr: Biletler kişi başı yirmi dolar.

meanings.tr: fark edilebilir şekilde, gözle görülür biçimde
meanings.en: in a way that can be noticed or seen
meanings.exampleEn: The temperature dropped perceptibly as the sun went down.
meanings.exampleTr: Güneş batarken sıcaklık fark edilir biçimde düştü.

meanings.tr: periyodik olarak, belirli aralıklarla, ara sıra
meanings.en: from time to time; at regular intervals
meanings.exampleEn: The machine should be checked periodically for faults.
meanings.exampleTr: Makine arızalara karşı belirli aralıklarla kontrol edilmelidir.

meanings.en: at an angle of 90° to a given line or surface
meanings.exampleEn: Draw a line perpendicular to the base of the triangle.
meanings.exampleTr: Üçgenin tabanına dik bir çizgi çiz.

meanings.en: never ending or changing; continuing all the time
meanings.exampleEn: I'm tired of his perpetual complaints about the weather.
meanings.exampleTr: Havayla ilgili sürekli şikâyetlerinden bıktım.

meanings.en: to confuse or worry someone because they cannot understand something
meanings.exampleEn: The strange results continued to perplex the scientists.
meanings.exampleTr: Tuhaf sonuçlar bilim insanlarının kafasını karıştırmaya devam etti.

meanings.en: difficult to understand; confusing
meanings.exampleEn: The instructions were so perplexing that no one could follow them.
meanings.exampleTr: Talimatlar o kadar kafa karıştırıcıydı ki kimse takip edemedi.

meanings.en: a person who treats others cruelly or unfairly, especially because of their beliefs or race
meanings.exampleEn: He eventually confronted his former persecutor in court.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonunda kendisine zulmeden eski kişiyle mahkemede yüzleşti.

meanings.en: the quality of being relevant or appropriate to a particular matter
meanings.exampleEn: The committee questioned the pertinence of his remarks to the debate.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurul, onun sözlerinin tartışmayla ilgililiğini sorguladı.

meanings.en: to make someone anxious or worried
meanings.exampleEn: The sudden change in his behaviour began to perturb his colleagues.
meanings.exampleTr: Davranışındaki ani değişiklik meslektaşlarını tedirgin etmeye başladı.

meanings.en: a natural substance that gives colour to plants, skin, and other tissues
meanings.exampleEn: Chlorophyll is the green pigment found in most plants.
meanings.exampleTr: Klorofil, çoğu bitkide bulunan yeşil pigmenttir.

meanings.tr: pigmentasyon, renklenme (doku veya derinin doğal rengi)
meanings.en: the natural colouring of living tissue, especially skin
meanings.exampleEn: Exposure to the sun can cause changes in skin pigmentation.
meanings.exampleTr: Güneşe maruz kalmak deri pigmentasyonunda değişikliklere yol açabilir.

meanings.en: a cloth cover for a pillow; a pillowcase
meanings.exampleEn: She changed the pillowslip because it was stained.
meanings.exampleTr: Lekelendiği için yastık kılıfını değiştirdi.

meanings.en: calm and peaceful, not easily excited or annoyed
meanings.exampleEn: She has a placid temperament and rarely loses her temper.
meanings.exampleTr: Sakin bir mizacı var ve nadiren öfkelenir.

meanings.en: the quality of being simple and without decoration or complexity
meanings.exampleEn: The plainness of the room made it feel calm and uncluttered.
meanings.exampleTr: Odanın sadeliği ona sakin ve derli toplu bir hava veriyordu.

meanings.en: long flat pieces of wood used in building
meanings.exampleEn: They laid wooden planks across the mud to make a path.
meanings.exampleTr: Yol yapmak için çamurun üzerine tahta kalaslar serdiler.

meanings.en: a scientist who studies plants and how they grow
meanings.exampleEn: The plant scientist developed a new variety of drought-resistant wheat.
meanings.exampleTr: Bitki bilimci kuraklığa dayanıklı yeni bir buğday çeşidi geliştirdi.

meanings.en: made from or based on plants rather than animal products
meanings.exampleEn: More people are switching to a plant-based diet for health reasons.
meanings.exampleTr: Giderek daha fazla insan sağlık nedeniyle bitki temelli beslenmeye geçiyor.

meanings.en: a large area of high, flat land
meanings.exampleEn: The village sits on a windswept plateau high in the mountains.
meanings.exampleTr: Köy, dağların yüksek kesimlerinde rüzgârlı bir platoda yer alıyor.

meanings.en: a period when a level of activity or progress stays the same
meanings.exampleEn: Sales reached a plateau after months of rapid growth.
meanings.exampleTr: Satışlar aylarca süren hızlı büyümenin ardından durağan bir düzeye ulaştı.

meanings.en: seeming likely to be true or reasonable
meanings.exampleEn: His excuse sounded plausible, so we decided to believe him.
meanings.exampleTr: Bahanesi akla yatkın geldi, biz de ona inanmaya karar verdik.

meanings.en: to emphasize something or make it seem more important than it is
meanings.exampleEn: The newspapers played up the scandal to sell more copies.
meanings.exampleTr: Gazeteler daha fazla satmak için skandalı abarttı.

meanings.en: to behave badly or not work properly
meanings.exampleEn: My knee has been playing up since the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Dizim kazadan beri beni rahatsız edip duruyor.

meanings.tr: avam, halktan biri, sıradan kişi (özellikle antik Roma'da)
meanings.en: an ordinary person of the lower social classes, especially in ancient Rome
meanings.exampleEn: In ancient Rome, a plebeian had far fewer rights than a patrician.
meanings.exampleTr: Antik Roma'da bir avam, bir soyluya göre çok daha az hakka sahipti.

meanings.en: ordinary people of the lower social classes, especially in ancient Rome
meanings.exampleEn: The plebeians demanded a greater say in how the city was governed.
meanings.exampleTr: Avam, şehrin nasıl yönetildiği konusunda daha fazla söz hakkı istedi.

meanings.tr: -e söz vermek, taahhüt etmek, ant içmek
meanings.en: to make a formal or serious promise to do something
meanings.exampleEn: The government pledged to reduce carbon emissions by 2030.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet 2030'a kadar karbon emisyonlarını azaltmaya söz verdi.

meanings.tr: bol bol, çok sayıda, bir sürü
meanings.en: a large amount or number of something; enough or more than enough
meanings.exampleEn: Don't worry, we have plenty of time to catch the train.
meanings.exampleTr: Merak etme, treni yakalamak için bol bol vaktimiz var.

meanings.en: a clever plan or trick used to gain an advantage
meanings.exampleEn: Lowering the price was just a ploy to attract new customers.
meanings.exampleTr: Fiyatı düşürmek, yeni müşteri çekmek için bir taktikten ibaretti.

meanings.en: to connect a piece of electrical equipment to an electricity supply
meanings.exampleEn: Remember to plug in the laptop before the battery dies.
meanings.exampleTr: Pil bitmeden dizüstü bilgisayarı prize takmayı unutma.

meanings.en: to try to understand or examine something completely
meanings.exampleEn: The novel attempts to plumb the depths of human despair.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman, insan çaresizliğinin derinliklerini kavramaya çalışıyor.

meanings.en: to connect an appliance or building to a water supply
meanings.exampleEn: A plumber came to plumb in the new washing machine.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni çamaşır makinesinin tesisatını bağlamak için bir tesisatçı geldi.

meanings.en: to steal goods from a place, especially using force during a war
meanings.exampleEn: The invading army plundered the city and burned its temples.
meanings.exampleTr: İstilacı ordu şehri yağmaladı ve tapınaklarını yaktı.

meanings.en: used to show that one number or amount is added to another
meanings.exampleEn: Two plus three equals five.
meanings.exampleTr: İki artı üç, beş eder.

meanings.en: and also; in addition
meanings.exampleEn: The flat is spacious, plus it's close to the station.
meanings.exampleTr: Daire ferah, üstelik istasyona da yakın.

meanings.en: to cook food, especially eggs or fish, gently in liquid just below boiling point
meanings.exampleEn: I like to poach an egg for breakfast.
meanings.exampleTr: Kahvaltıda yumurta haşlamayı severim.

meanings.en: to illegally hunt or catch animals on someone else's land
meanings.exampleEn: Hunters continue to poach elephants for their ivory.
meanings.exampleTr: Avcılar fildişi için hâlâ kaçak fil avlıyor.

meanings.en: to take staff or customers from a rival, especially unfairly
meanings.exampleEn: The firm tried to poach our best engineers with higher salaries.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, daha yüksek maaşlarla en iyi mühendislerimizi ayartmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: a person's financial resources or budget; also a small wallet or handbag
meanings.exampleEn: Rising fuel prices are hitting every family's pocketbook.
meanings.exampleTr: Artan yakıt fiyatları her ailenin bütçesini vuruyor.

meanings.en: to push a finger or a pointed object into or at someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: She poked him in the ribs to wake him up.
meanings.exampleTr: Onu uyandırmak için kaburgalarına dürttü.

meanings.en: to appear or push out through an opening
meanings.exampleEn: A few weeds poked through the cracks in the pavement.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç ot, kaldırımdaki çatlaklardan dışarı uzanıyordu.

meanings.en: a person, company, or country that causes pollution
meanings.exampleEn: The factory was named as the region's worst polluter.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika, bölgenin en büyük kirleticisi olarak gösterildi.

meanings.tr: çok yönlü bilgin, hezarfen, çok alanda uzman kişi
meanings.en: a person who knows a lot about many different subjects
meanings.exampleEn: Leonardo da Vinci was a true polymath, skilled in art, science, and engineering.
meanings.exampleTr: Leonardo da Vinci, sanat, bilim ve mühendislikte usta gerçek bir hezarfendi.
